name: Funnel
description: The first clip narrows into a curved funnel toward a point on the bottom edge and slides into it, like a window minimized into a dock, revealing the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: neck_x
params.description: Point of the bottom edge where the clip disappears, from left (0) to right (1)

params.name: curvature
params.description: Shape of the funnel's sides: 0 straight, 1 bent into an S curve

params.name: shadow
params.description: Strength of the shading of the bent clip and of the shadow it casts
